entries.name: Gemini CLI
entries.description: The official open-source AI agent that brings the power of Gemini directly into your terminal. Features context-aware coding assistance, file manipulation, and command execution capabilities.

entries.name: Gemini CLI cookbook
entries.description: Official collection of examples and guides demonstrating best practices for using the Gemini API. Essential resource for developers getting started.

entries.name: Run Gemini CLI
entries.description: Official GitHub Action that seamlessly integrates Gemini into your CI/CD pipeline, enabling automated code reviews, testing, and documentation generation.

entries.name: Gemini CLI Desktop
entries.description: Beautiful desktop and web UI that makes Gemini CLI accessible to non-terminal/mobile users while preserving all its powerful features.

entries.name: AionUi
entries.description: Free, local, open-source GUI app for Gemini CLI — Better Chat UI, File Management, AI image editing, multi-agent support, multi-LLMs & apikey polling, code diff view & more.

entries.name: Yaw
entries.description: Cross-platform terminal that auto-detects Gemini CLI and opens a split-pane workflow with a companion terminal.

entries.name: Termly
entries.description: Free native iOS and Android app to monitor and control Gemini CLI (and other CLI AI assistants) remotely. Zero-knowledge E2E encryption, pairs in under 60 seconds via QR code. No subscriptions, no usage limits.

entries.name: Agent Workbench
entries.description: Local web UI for Antigravity CLI (agy), the official successor to Gemini CLI: tabs, browsable history, conversations as cards, and its status and context meter through the status line. Runs Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode side by side and hands a conversation over from one CLI to another. It doesn't drive Gemini CLI itself; the repository includes a one-off importer for old Gemini CLI chats.

entries.name: AnywhereDesign
entries.description: Local-first voice cockpit and remote mobile interface for Claude Code & Antigravity/Gemini CLI. Control terminal agent sessions from your phone via local QR code, real-time voice dictation, live terminal output streaming, and zero-token mobile Git sync.

entries.name: Mobile SSH
entries.description: Android and iOS (TestFlight beta) SSH client for running Gemini CLI on remote servers, with a Gemini CLI installer plugin, simultaneous terminal sessions, and tmux session management.

entries.name: Bellows
entries.description: Desktop workspace that runs Gemini CLI over ACP alongside Claude and Codex, with diffs, permission prompts, team rules, a hash-linked audit trail and live session sharing. Windows, macOS and Linux.

entries.name: Alchemist Coder
entries.description: Open-source desktop app for Windows, macOS and Linux that indexes your Gemini CLI chats, together with Claude Code, Codex and Grok Build sessions, into one local, read-only full-text search. Running Gemini CLI over ACP inside the app is planned for its upcoming Pro edition; the free edition runs Claude Code and Codex on local models.

entries.name: SwarmPane
entries.description: Desktop app for Mac, Windows and Linux that runs Gemini CLI (with a Gemini API key) side by side with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor Agent, Copilot, Devin and more, up to 16 at once in real terminals, with a git worktree per agent, undo for every agent step and account switching when a usage limit hits. Paid, with a 7-day trial for $1.

entries.name: LLxprt Code
entries.description: An open-source multi-provider (including local) fork of Gemini CLI. Use whatever LLM you want to code in your terminal.

entries.name: iFlow CLI
entries.description: Powerful fork that extends Gemini CLI with repository analysis, context interpretation, and complex workflow automation. Perfect for teams needing advanced orchestration capabilities.

entries.name: Qwen Code
entries.description: Fork by the team behind Qwen LLM. Uses Qwen instead of Gemini.

entries.name: loopguard
entries.description: Watchdog that tails Gemini CLI session transcripts and alerts when the agent loops, oscillates, or stalls — Telegram notifications, zero dependencies.

entries.name: Ralph Harness
entries.description: Tiny Python scaffold for running Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex CLI, and similar coding agents in guarded local loops. It uses repo-local specs, fresh-context iterations, hard caps, git-hook gates, CI verification, and coverage gates.

entries.name: Bernstein
entries.description: Multi-agent orchestrator that coordinates Gemini CLI alongside Claude Code and Codex CLI. Spawns parallel coding agents from a single goal, verifies with tests, auto-commits. Deterministic Python coordination, zero LLM tokens on orchestration.

entries.name: Tars
entries.description: A local-first autonomous supervisor and sidekick powered by Google Gemini. Features background persistence (heartbeat), tiered local memory, multi-channel notifications (Discord/WhatsApp), and self-healing background services. Designed for reliable, long-running agentic orchestration in the terminal.

entries.name: hcom
entries.description: Let AI agents message, watch, and spawn each other across terminals. First-class Gemini CLI support with hooks integration and PTY wrapper. Also works with Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode.

entries.name: squads-cli
entries.description: Open source CLI for AI agent coordination that organizes agents into domain-aligned squads with persistent memory, goal tracking, and Git-native state. Works with Gemini CLI.

entries.name: wolfpack
entries.description: Mobile & desktop command center for controlling AI coding agents (Claude, Codex, Gemini) across machines from your phone. Secured by Tailscale. Self-hosted.

entries.name: Untether
entries.description: Telegram bridge for Gemini CLI (and 5 other agents). Send tasks by voice, stream progress, configure approval mode (read-only/edit files/full access) via inline buttons. Self-hosted, MIT licensed.

entries.name: Parallel Code
entries.description: Desktop app for orchestrating multiple AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI) simultaneously in isolated git worktrees.

entries.name: clideck
entries.description: WhatsApp-like dashboard for managing multiple AI coding agents (including Gemini CLI) in one browser window. Live status, session resume, autopilot that routes work between agents while afk, mobile remote to check in from a phone.

entries.name: ToutKit
entries.description: Desktop notebook with a built-in terminal that runs Gemini CLI alongside Claude Code and Codex; an in-app webview renders whatever the agent writes inline, and each note is a self-contained folder with its own SQLite, files, and scripts. Local-first, Electron, AGPL-3.0.

entries.name: Ivy Tendril
entries.description: Open-source desktop app that orchestrates Gemini CLI alongside Claude Code, Codex, and Copilot through a plan-based lifecycle with verification gates, self-improving memory, and git worktree isolation. Local-first, agent-agnostic, FSL licensed.

entries.name: postmortemthis
entries.description: Runs Gemini CLI alongside your other coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Qwen, Vibe) in parallel and read-only over your diff, then synthesizes their reviews into one ship / no-ship verdict. A cross-model review panel.

entries.name: AgentBox
entries.description: Run multiple coding agents (Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode) in parallel, each teleported into its own sandboxed VM — local Docker, self-hosted, or cloud (Hetzner, Daytona, Vercel, E2B, DigitalOcean). Sub-1s checkpoint startup; git credentials stay on the host. MIT.

entries.name: DevIntern
entries.description: Tool that picks up tickets from Jira, Linear, Trello, Asana, Azure DevOps, GitHub Issues, or markdown files and turns them into self-reviewed pull requests by driving Gemini CLI non-interactively (also supports Claude Code, Codex, and others). A feasibility gate flags vague tickets back to the tracker with questions; optional unattended mode schedules ticket pickup and turns PR review comments into commits. Runs on your machines with your own Google keys. FSL-1.1, free for interactive use.

entries.name: PickySteve
entries.description: Skill router and context picker for coding agents: a local model (via Ollama, offline by default) routes each prompt to the right skill via hybrid BM25 + embedding retrieval, cross-encoder rerank, and an LLM judge, then assembles a minimal context bundle for the execution model. Built-in prompt-injection gate scans every retrieved document, fail-closed. Ships an MCP stdio server and an OpenAI-compatible proxy; one-command installer wires 18 coding agents including Gemini CLI. MIT.

entries.name: Agentlas OS
entries.description: Local-first Agent Operation Environment (AOE) that installs into Gemini CLI and other supported hosts to build, route, and run specialist agent teams with portable packages, permissions, and verification gates.

entries.name: intentic
entries.description: Self-hosted workspace that runs Gemini CLI over ACP (gemini --experimental-acp) alongside Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode. Each agent gets its own Docker container and git worktree on hardware you own; terminals survive disconnects, any browser or phone reopens the same fleet, and changes land through per-file, per-hunk diff review. Scheduled and webhook-triggered runs. MIT.

entries.name: SandBase CLI
entries.description: Open-source CLI and MCP bridge that configures Gemini CLI and other AI coding agents to access 2,000+ AI models and APIs through one account.

entries.name: godmode
entries.description: Discipline layer for AI coding agents: 135 skills and 7 subagents that wrap Gemini CLI (and Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Amp, and pi) in a measure → modify → verify → keep/revert loop with automatic rollback of failed changes. MIT.

entries.name: YYLO
entries.description: Kanban-driven CLI orchestrator that runs Gemini CLI alongside Claude Code and Codex in parallel across isolated git worktrees, with a merge queue that reviews and merges verified task work. Git-native task state, per-agent worktree isolation, installable via npm. MIT.

entries.name: VibeFuse
entries.description: Free Windows desktop harness that runs Gemini CLI alongside Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Qwen as live draggable widgets on one canvas, with named sessions, local Whisper/Piper voice, an MCP tool panel, and a marketplace where skill and widget sellers keep 80% (Stripe Connect).

entries.name: agent-manager
entries.description: Terminal UI that runs Gemini CLI alongside Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and other coding-agent CLIs, each in its own persistent tmux session. One list shows every session's live status, prompts go into a pane without attaching, a session can spawn into its own Git worktree, and a full-file diff review sends line comments back to the agent. Launches your installed Gemini CLI unmodified, so login, config and MCP servers carry over. macOS, Linux and Windows via WSL2. Apache-2.0.

entries.name: puenteo
entries.description: Gemini CLI extension + MCP server that lets Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex and Cursor sessions on one machine search each other's history and message each other live (send/wait/reply, channels, file claims). Local SQLite, no daemon.

entries.name: Mudroom
entries.description: Runs Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex, Aider and opencode inside a Linux micro-VM on a copy-on-write clone of your project, with a network allowlist and a pull-request-style diff review before changes are applied.

entries.name: Drevon
entries.description: Mac app that connects to your Claude Code or Codex and turns it into an end-to-end GTM operator: research, grunt work, analysis and actions across your stack from a single prompt, in your own browser with your own logins.

entries.name: DHI Orbit
entries.description: Local web dashboard that lists Gemini CLI and Antigravity chats alongside Claude Code, Codex and Cursor on one board, with what needs an answer and a reply box (gemini --resume <id> -p). Python standard library only, MIT.

entries.name: Crewly
entries.description: MIT-licensed, local platform that runs a team of role-based agents (developer, QA, PM, orchestrator) on Gemini CLI, Claude Code, and Codex, with task delegation through agent skills, shared persistent memory, and a web dashboard of live agent terminals. Requires one of these agent CLIs installed and logged in.

entries.name: magents
entries.description: Gemini CLI extension, MCP server and CLI over the session transcripts Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex, Copilot CLI, Cursor, Grok and OpenCode already write. List and read other live sessions, hand off compact state, send into a specific chat, or spawn a headless session that replies through a shared inbox. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/abnegate/magents. Rust, MIT.

entries.name: SpaceApp
entries.description: Self-hosted web workspace that runs Gemini CLI alongside OpenCode, Codex, Claude Code and other coding CLIs as side-by-side panes in persistent rooms, with MCP servers and managed browser panes. Install: npx --yes run-spaceapp@latest install. Source-available (BSL 1.1).

entries.name: AutoHarness
entries.description: Makes Gemini CLI (and Claude Code, Codex, Qwen Code) prepare before it builds: splits the task into areas of know-how, finds or writes a skill for each, checks the result against the original, and lets a fresh critic judge it. MIT.

entries.name: Concord MCP
entries.description: Local-first shared work-state MCP server (npx -y @concord-ai/concord-mcp) that lets coding agents coordinate on one repo through presence, file claims, messaging, handoffs and review packets. Works with Gemini CLI alongside Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other agents. TypeScript, stdio, MIT.

entries.name: LitGravity
entries.description: Adds lit to the Antigravity CLI (agy) so a request is planned, built with tests and recorded checks, reviewed, and closed with a handoff note.

entries.name: MAO
entries.description: Native desktop canvas for macOS, Windows and Linux that runs Gemini CLI (0.41 or later) as a built-in agent alongside Claude Code, Codex, Grok, OpenCode, Antigravity and shell agents, each as a real terminal node on its own login. Wired agents hand each other tasks through the mao CLI, an Orchestrator agent can recruit and direct the others, and each layer is a git worktree whose diff you review and land from the canvas. Closed source; US$20 one-time, 7-day free trial.

entries.name: Aixle Flow
entries.description: Self-hosted Kanban board that runs Gemini CLI alongside Claude Code, Codex, Cursor CLI and other coding agents, each in its own container. Moving a card starts a durable workflow with parallel steps, approval gates and per-run token and cost tracking.

entries.name: llm-box
entries.description: Terminal-first workflow automation engine. Generate and execute YAML workflows from plain English. 20+ built-in nodes (fetch_url, execute, file I/O, HTTP, JSON parsing, template rendering, LLM calls), 15+ LLM providers, and MCP server mode. Install via gemini extensions install https://github.com/alib8b8/llm-box.

entries.name: Task Monitor
entries.description: Prevents agent loops via message tracking and plays auditory notifications for long tasks or out-of-focus prompts.

entries.name: ATXP
entries.description: Give your Gemini CLI agent a wallet, email address, phone number, and 100+ paid MCP tools (web search, image gen, SMS, voice, LLM gateway). Self-register with gemini extensions install https://github.com/atxp-dev/atxp — no human login required, $5 free credits included.

entries.name: brooks-lint
entries.description: AI code reviews grounded in six classic engineering books. Diagnoses decay risks with structured findings (Symptom → Source → Consequence → Remedy).

entries.name: gemini-notifier
entries.description: A Gemini extension to send native system-level notifications when Gemini requests permissions.

entries.name: Pickle Rick
entries.description: This extension transforms the Gemini CLI into "Pickle Rick," a hyper-intelligent, arrogant, yet extremely competent engineering persona. It enforces a rigid, iterative software development lifecycle through continuous AI agent loops.

entries.name: gemini-beads
entries.description: Git-backed persistent memory and task management for Gemini CLI.

entries.name: Conductor
entries.description: Conductor is a Gemini CLI extension that allows you to specify, plan, and implement software features.

entries.name: Listen
entries.description: Run Gemini CLI as a server with /listen commands.

entries.name: Screenshare
entries.description: Screen sharing via MCP and custom slash commands.

entries.name: pyATS
entries.description: pyATS integration for network testing.

entries.name: Subnet calculator
entries.description: An extension for GeminiCLI that performs subnet calculation.

entries.name: Packet Buddy
entries.description: A Gemini CLI extension that uses RAG and MCP and Custom Slash Commands to analyze packet captures.

entries.name: gemini-cli-on-vscode
entries.description: MAGUS Council: World's first? 4-AI consultation system (Gemini+Claude+GPT-5+Qwen) in VS Code - Revolutionary multi-agent development environment

entries.name: GeminiCLI_Slash_Listen
entries.description: Innovative /listen command enabling remote Gemini CLI access through Slack, perfect for collaborative coding and remote assistance scenarios.

entries.name: gemini-cli-custom-slash-commands
entries.description: Curated collection of productivity-boosting custom slash commands that extend Gemini CLI with specialized workflows and shortcuts.

entries.name: gemini-flow
entries.description: Transforms Gemini CLI into an autonomous AI development team using proven Claude-Flow patterns, enabling complex multi-agent workflows.

entries.name: ru-text
entries.description: Russian text quality — ~1,040 rules for typography, info-style, editorial, UX writing, business correspondence.

entries.name: TokRepo Search Skill
entries.description: Cross-platform TokRepo skill with Gemini extension files for finding and installing AI assets such as prompts, MCP configs, workflows, and reusable skills.

entries.name: dRPC Agent Skills
entries.description: Query blockchain RPCs from Gemini CLI. Fetch balances, read contracts, and check gas prices via dRPC.

entries.name: OpenAccountants
entries.description: 371 tax classification skills across 134 countries. Classify bank statement transactions into VAT/GST, income tax, and social contribution categories with conservative defaults.

entries.name: gemini-discord
entries.description: Turn your local Gemini CLI agent into an always-on Discord presence that also doubles as your personal server admin.

entries.name: xberg-io plugins
entries.description: A suite of Gemini CLI extensions from Kreuzberg, Inc.: document extraction (xberg — 97+ formats with OCR), web crawling (crawlberg), HTML→Markdown, a universal LLM client for 143 providers (liter-llm), and code intelligence for 300+ languages (tree-sitter-language-pack). Install via gemini extensions install.

entries.name: 16-eyes
entries.description: AI-driven security audits via custom Gemini CLI commands and subagents (also supports Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) — profiles the repo, verifies every finding, adversarially disproves high-impact ones before they reach the report. Install via npx 16-eyes install --target gemini.

entries.name: wiki
entries.description: Indexed Markdown knowledge bases with a CLI and installable Agent Skill. wiki install writes the skill to ~/.agents/skills, which Gemini CLI discovers.

entries.name: ArmorGemini
entries.description: Intent-based security enforcement for the Gemini CLI. Every tool call is checked against your ArmorIQ policy via BeforeTool / AfterTool hooks before it runs. Blocks intent drift, unauthorized tool use, and PII/PCI leaks. Install: curl -fsSL https://armoriq.ai/install_armorgemini.sh | bash.

entries.name: Punchcard
entries.description: Architecture-level code review grounded in thirty engineering books distilled into 78 principles. Three independent passes over a working tree, branch or PR, merged into one verdict; every blocker demonstrated by running the code. Install with npx skills add Maksim-Burtsev/punchcard -a gemini-cli.

entries.name: Knowledge Delta Skills
entries.description: Portable SKILL.md skills for media buying, frontend, security, research, and skill authoring, each kept to what a frontier model does not already reliably know. Copy any skill directory into ~/.gemini/skills/ and Gemini CLI discovers it.

entries.name: iOS Agent Skill
entries.description: Gemini CLI extension with Swift development guidance, read-only code review tools, and local Apple source/reference retrieval.

entries.name: LintLang
entries.description: Static linter and Gemini CLI extension for agent instructions, tool descriptions, and prompt configuration.

entries.name: Cohesivity
entries.description: cohesivity.ai offers free agent native backend services. Anonymous account (no-signup) to get started through MCP or API. Hosting, postgres, email, storage, containers, LLMs, voice and third-party APIs. Includes free tiers and 5 USD/mo in AI and Search credits. Top-ups through x402.

entries.name: AIHawk
entries.description: Gives Gemini CLI a real Firefox to drive from plain-English instructions: opens pages, clicks, types, reads and screenshots through the real pointer and keyboard. Open source, MIT. Install via gemini extensions install https://github.com/feder-cr/AIHawk.

entries.name: kgai
entries.description: Shared decision memory for AI dev teams: your agent records why the code changed (and the dead ends it ruled out), recalls it before the next edit, and syncs it across the team without merge conflicts. Local-first, immutable, engine installs itself on first run.

entries.name: isitdone
entries.description: Gemini CLI extension that refuses to let the agent end its turn claiming "done" until the repository's real test, typecheck and lint commands pass. An AfterAgent hook runs them on the exact working tree and feeds the failing output back; an AfterTool hook warns when an edit weakened a test. No LLM calls, no network. Install via gemini extensions install https://github.com/raimondasl/isitdone-gemini.

entries.name: GTD Brain
entries.description: Getting Things Done (GTD) task board for Gemini CLI: capture to your Inbox, next actions by context, projects, Waiting For and a guided weekly review over a hosted MCP server, plus a GEMINI.md context file and /gtd:* commands. Sign in with an email code, no API key; same board as the GTD Brain web, iOS and Android apps. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/minosin/gtdbrain-gemini-extension.

entries.name: SuperSearch
entries.description: Local Python CLI/library that fans out bounded searches across web, code, community, and research sources and returns source-explicit JSON receipts.

entries.name: Clera
entries.description: Gemini CLI extension for hiring: search 210,000+ vetted startup candidates, review Clera's picks for your open roles and request intros through Clera's hosted OAuth MCP server.

entries.name: Hermeneutic
entries.description: Gemini CLI extension that reviews final-response wording for completion and certainty claims, then requests at most one evidence-focused revision through an AfterAgent hook. Runs the deterministic check locally.

entries.name: since-cutoff
entries.description: Gemini CLI extension (MCP server + skill) that tells the agent what changed in your Python dependencies since the model's training cutoff: a static diff of each library's public API between the release at the cutoff and the version your lockfile pins, with no model calls or API key. Install via gemini extensions install https://github.com/MohammadHijjawi97/since-cutoff.

entries.name: Better Design
entries.description: Gemini CLI extension that connects the Better Design MCP server: design systems, UI and UX principles, icons and UI review for the interfaces the agent builds. Install with gemini extensions install https://github.com/better-designs/better-design-plugin; sign in with a free account on first connect.

entries.name: dejavu
entries.description: Cross-session error gates: recurring tool-call failures become enforced remind-first, block-on-repeat gates via BeforeTool/AfterTool hooks. One store shared with Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor and more. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/WhiteBite/dejavu-gates. MIT.

entries.name: Kin
entries.description: Gemini CLI extension for Kin, a graph-native code repository for people and AI agents. Its MCP server lets Gemini look up callers, references and history from the same record you inspect with the kin CLI.

entries.name: PlaceCall
entries.description: Gemini CLI extension (skill + remote MCP server) that places real outbound phone calls to US businesses for bookings, inquiries and quotes, and returns the outcome and transcript. Paid API. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/voygr-tech/placecall.

entries.name: 8B AI Website Builder
entries.description: Gemini CLI extension that builds an animated one-page website: the agent picks an 8B generated design, writes the copy and returns a preview link, plain-word edits and one HTML file. Remote MCP https://mcp.8b.com/mcp, no account or API key. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/8bsite/8b-agent-plugin.

entries.name: Supercov
entries.description: Coverage, security and code quality for coding agents. Gemini CLI extension that runs the project's existing tests, measures line, branch and MC/DC coverage, and hands Gemini the untested code to test next. Install with gemini extensions install https://github.com/supercorp-ai/supercov.

entries.name: figma-maxxing
entries.description: Gemini CLI extension with 8 skills for agents editing real Figma files: Plugin API gotchas, checks before and after every write, comments to verified fixes, and a handoff gate. Built on figma-console-mcp; 3 of the checks also ran once on Figma's official MCP server. MIT. Install via gemini extensions install https://github.com/thiagoxikota/figma-maxxing.

entries.name: NotWorking
entries.description: Downdetector for AI agents: a skill and remote MCP server that checks whether other agents report the same site, skill or MCP server failure, and takes failure reports. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/RyanNSJ/notworking.

entries.name: assay
entries.description: Deterministic QA for web pages, with a Gemini CLI skill. assay opens the page in Chromium with Playwright, drives every control, and reports where the page contradicts itself, with no LLM and the same result on every run. The skill tells Gemini CLI to run assay after it changes a page and report what it found. Install with pip install assay-ui, then add the skill file. MIT.

entries.name: brethof-brain
entries.description: Gemini CLI extension for the hosted brethof-brain memory: with every prompt, the records that bear on it arrive before Gemini answers; a brief at session start; every turn archived; the same memory is shared with Claude Code, Codex and other agents. Needs a brethof-brain account (free plan). Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/BrethofAI/brethof-brain-client.

entries.name: PostEverywhere
entries.description: Social media scheduler for Gemini CLI. Write, schedule and publish posts to Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, X, Threads, Pinterest and Bluesky, and plan a content calendar. Install with gemini extensions install https://github.com/posteverywhere/gemini-cli-extension (posteverywhere.ai).

entries.name: MoltNode by Chord
entries.description: Gemini CLI extension that connects two hosted MCP servers and a GEMINI.md context file: MoltNode for JSON-RPC reads on 31 blockchains, and Chord for DEX swap quotes and unsigned swap transactions on Base, Monad, BNB Chain, Avalanche, Arbitrum, Robinhood Chain and Arc, plus token boards, candles and wallet PnL. No API key; the agent's own wallet signs every transaction. MIT. Install via gemini extensions install https://github.com/tuantqse90/moltnode-mcp.

entries.name: Thinking Methods
entries.description: Curated Agent Skills (SKILL.md) for structured thinking on real decisions: five whys, pre-mortem, trade-offs, prioritization, six thinking hats, and twelve more methods plus a selector skill. Install as a Gemini extension (gemini extensions install https://github.com/ysskrishna/ai-agent-skills) or skills only (gemini skills install https://github.com/ysskrishna/ai-agent-skills.git --path skills). MIT.

entries.name: Kuudo Skills
entries.description: Gemini CLI extension with 22 Agent Skills for Amazon sellers and advertisers: Sponsored Products and Brands audits, search-term mining, budget pacing, DSP and Amazon Marketing Cloud, listings, product images, repricing, FBA inbound, and profitability, built for Kuudo's hosted Amazon Ads and SP-API MCP servers. Price, budget, listing, and shipment writes are previewed and wait for your approval. Install with gemini extensions install https://github.com/KuudoAI/skills. PolyForm Shield 1.0.0 (source-available).

entries.name: Gemini Safety Net
entries.description: Gemini CLI extension that runs cc-safety-net as a BeforeTool hook. It blocks destructive Git and filesystem commands, and reads of secrets such as SSH keys and .env files, before Gemini runs the tool call. It parses the command, so wrapped forms such as bash -c are also checked. It is not a sandbox. MIT. Install with gemini extensions install https://github.com/kenryu42/gemini-safety-net.

entries.name: US Watchlist Alerts
entries.description: Agent Skills (SKILL.md) for a US stock watchlist: NYSE-aware, de-duplicated price alerts (levels, % moves, gaps, 52-week highs/lows, MA crosses, RSI, earnings) and morning/close briefs. Stdlib Python, no API key, never places trades. MIT. Install with npx skills add eli-alvarado/us-watchlist-alerts -y -a gemini-cli.

entries.name: Dex
entries.description: Gemini CLI extension with three Agent Skills for analytics engineering: explore a warehouse or DuckDB file read-only (profiles, PII flags, verified joins), author dbt models and semantic layers as reviewable diffs, and detect schema drift. Install with gemini extensions install https://github.com/exmergo/dex; needs uv.

entries.name: UI Verify
entries.description: Visual testing for coding agents: your agent sees every UI change it makes, so visual bugs never reach production. Gemini CLI extension with 9 Agent Skills (set up visual regression tests for Storybook, Playwright and Vitest, keep captures deterministic, triage a build's changes) and the hosted UI Verify MCP server (15 tools) that shows the agent each change as a before and after against the baseline and lets it accept the intended ones. OAuth login in the browser, no API key in config. Skills are MIT; the service is hosted, free for 10,000 snapshots a month and 50,000 for open-source projects. Install with gemini extensions install https://github.com/uiverify/uiverify, then run /mcp auth uiverify.

entries.name: Recommerce
entries.description: Agent Skills (SKILL.md) for second-hand purchases: compare listings, assemble kits, inspect items, plan collection, weigh keep vs. repair vs. replace, and recheck before committing. Read-only, no API key, never contacts sellers or buys. MIT. Install with npx skills add budna-marketplace/recommerce -y -a gemini-cli.

entries.name: frugal
entries.description: Gemini CLI extension and Agent Skill: before anything is bought, subscribed to or upgraded, Gemini checks free tiers, the right plan and billing period, startup, student, open-source and nonprofit programs, verified promo codes and cheaper alternatives, then reports the best options with sources. Never pays by itself. MIT. Install with gemini extensions install https://github.com/fainir/frugal.

entries.name: Oh My Logo
entries.description: Adds personality to your terminal with giant ASCII-art logos featuring beautiful color gradients, perfect for customizing your Gemini CLI startup experience.

entries.name: tldr
entries.description: Leads every response with a three-line TL;DR and folds the full detail underneath, so the answer is not buried. Never folds destructive commands, security findings, verbatim errors or diffs. Returns a parseable block for agent-to-agent reports. Ships a Gemini CLI extension.

entries.name: agnix
entries.description: Linter for AI agent configurations. Validates GEMINI.md, SKILL.md, hooks, MCP, and more with 156 rules, auto-fix, and LSP server for real-time editor diagnostics.

entries.name: Self Command
entries.description: Allows the Gemini CLI to send commands to itself, run very long commands in the background and be woken, sleep for a specified amount of time, watch logs and receive notifications, etc by leveraging tmux. Reduces usage and improves reliability by avoiding loop detection. After installing the extension you must lauch gemini-cli into a tmux session named "gemini-cli".

entries.name: vsync
entries.description: Sync Skills, MCP servers, Agents & Commands across Claude Code, Cursor, OpenCode, Codex, and Gemini CLI with automatic format conversion (JSON ↔ TOML ↔ JSONC).

entries.name: Gemini Dockerized CLI
entries.description: Gemini Dockerized CLI with small improvements.

entries.name: IssueDB
entries.description: LLM frendly command-line issue tracking system for software development projects, with built-in interface, context support and prompt providers for Gemini CLI and others.

entries.name: Docker Gemini CLI
entries.description: Gemini CLI wrapped as a Docker image, so you don't need to trash your OS with Node and its dependencies.

entries.name: Rulesync
entries.description: The Node.js CLI tool that automatically generates configs (rules, ignore files, MCP servers, commands, and subagents) for various AI coding agents. Rulesync can convert configs between Gemini CLI and other AI agents in both directions.

entries.name: Pluribus
entries.description: Sync one canonical project context into native AI coding-agent rule files, including Gemini CLI GEMINI.md, Claude Code CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md, Cursor, Cline, Roo Code, Amazon Q, Junie, Warp, Copilot, Windsurf, Continue, Zed, OpenCode, and OpenClaw.

entries.name: Nix AI Tools
entries.description: Seamless Nix integration for reproducible Gemini CLI installations. Ensures consistent environments across teams and simplifies deployment with declarative configuration.

entries.name: Terminal Jarvis
entries.description: Ultimate command center unifying multiple AI coding assistants in one elegant interface. Switch between tools seamlessly and manage sessions efficiently.

entries.name: rule-gen
entries.description: Generate AI coding rules from your actual codebase using Google Gemini. Feeds source files into Gemini's 1M token context window and produces project-specific rules. Supports Cursor (.mdc), Claude Code (CLAUDE.md), Copilot, and Windsurf output formats. Zero dependencies.

entries.name: Splitrail
entries.description: Comprehensive usage analytics platform that tracks and optimizes your Gemini CLI workflows, helping teams understand and improve their AI-assisted development patterns.

entries.name: ccmanager
entries.description: Essential session management tool that saves, restores, and organizes multiple Gemini CLI sessions, perfect for juggling multiple projects or experiments.

entries.name: Agent Sessions
entries.description: Local-first macOS app to search, browse, and resume Gemini CLI sessions alongside Codex CLI, Claude Code, OpenCode, and other agents, with live iTerm2 monitoring via Agent Cockpit.

entries.name: codebase-recon
entries.description: AI agent skill that analyzes git history to reveal codebase hotspots, bug magnets, bus factor risks, and development momentum before reading any code. Works with Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Cursor, and 20+ other coding agents.

entries.name: Gemini CLI Logs Prettifier
entries.description: Renders the logs human readable (prettifies them) and browsable as interlinked HTML, with thoughtful explanations and clickable links.

entries.name: Signum
entries.description: Evidence-driven development pipeline that uses Gemini CLI as one of three independent reviewers in a multi-model code audit panel (alongside Claude and Codex).

entries.name: unslop
entries.description: CLI and MCP server that removes AI writing patterns from text: tricolons, em-dash overuse, hedging stacks, sycophancy openers, and overused vocabulary. Works with any MCP client including Gemini CLI. Five intensity levels and a lint-only audit mode. Useful for cleaning commit messages, PR descriptions, and documentation.

entries.name: agentwatch
entries.description: Local-only TUI + web dashboard that tails Gemini CLI sessions alongside Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Hermes, and OpenClaw on one unified timeline. Parses tokens, tools, and per-turn cost from each Gemini CLI session (gemini-2.5-pro / flash rates), plus context compaction visualizer, MAD z-score anomaly detection, MCP server mode, and OpenTelemetry exporter. No cloud, no telemetry. macOS + Linux. MIT.

entries.name: agenttrace
entries.description: Local-first TUI for Gemini CLI and AI coding agent session observability. Parses local logs for cost, tokens, tool failures, latency, anomalies, health gates, and diffs across Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex CLI, Aider, Cursor exports, OpenCode, and more.

entries.name: andrej-karpathy-skills
entries.description: Npm installer for Karpathy-inspired GEMINI.md guidelines, plus adapters for Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, OpenCode, OpenClaw, Windsurf, and Aider.

entries.name: authsome
entries.description: Local credential broker for AI agents. OAuth2 and API key vault stored locally, a loopback HTTPS proxy injects credentials into outbound provider requests so the Gemini CLI agent never sees raw secrets. 45 providers bundled (GitHub, Google, OpenAI, Linear, Slack, Notion, Resend, Stripe, ...). Python 3.13+, MIT.

entries.name: Wasla
entries.description: TypeScript CLI that syncs agents, MCP configs, skills, commands, and workflow assets across Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode/OpenClaw, and GitHub Copilot workflows.

entries.name: Lockpaw
entries.description: macOS menu bar screen guard for unattended Gemini CLI runs. One hotkey covers the screen and blocks input while the agent keeps running (no sleep), and the locked screen glows plus fires a notification when Gemini CLI needs input or finishes, via a lockpaw ping hook. Touch ID unlock. Also works with Claude Code and Codex. Native Swift, free, open source.

entries.name: Tintpad
entries.description: macOS menu bar launcher for the agentic-coding loop. One hotkey opens your terminal at the right repo with Gemini CLI (or Claude Code, Codex) already running. Frecency repo search, Safe/Default/YOLO run modes, git worktrees, headless background dispatch. Native Swift, local-only, free, open source.

entries.name: DOS
entries.description: Deterministic trust kernel for coding agents: hooks that verify "done" claims against git evidence and refuse file collisions between concurrent agents. Wires into Gemini CLI with dos init --hooks gemini; also ships an MCP server. Python, MIT.

entries.name: skillet
entries.description: Zero-dependency Go CLI / package manager that installs Agent Skills and MCP servers into Gemini CLI (and other tools), plus Claude Code slash commands and hooks.

entries.name: EGC
entries.description: Persistent cross-session memory for Gemini CLI and 12 other AI coding tools. SQLite-backed state survives context resets, install with npm install -g @egchq/egc.

entries.name: MCP Config Doctor
entries.description: Browser-local diagnostic that validates Gemini CLI ~/.gemini/settings.json MCP server entries (shape, env/secret references, transport fields). Also covers Claude Code, Codex CLI, and VS Code MCP configs. No account, no telemetry, no remote calls — runs entirely in the browser.

entries.name: Hexis
entries.description: Git-backed platform for skills, tools, and context for AI agents, available to Gemini CLI through a remote OAuth MCP server.

entries.name: claude-skills-pro
entries.description: 15 engineering-workflow skills (7-dimension code review, root-cause debugging, bug-catching test generation, behavior-preserving refactor, zero-downtime DB migration; 7 free/MIT) with CN/EN handbooks. Installs into Gemini CLI via the open skills installer: npx skills add Hahaknight/claude-skills-pro --agent gemini-cli (install path verified end-to-end in Gemini CLI).

entries.name: Devie AI Quota Tracker
entries.description: Dashboard and macOS menu bar for tracking AI subscription quotas in one place (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot, and Cursor). Supports multi-accounts, notifications, and session-timer start optimization.

entries.name: ClawMetry
entries.description: Self-hosted, local-first observability and kill switch for coding agents, reading Gemini CLI sessions alongside Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenClaw, Aider, Goose, and others. Reads the session logs the runtimes already write on disk, so there is no SDK and nothing in the request path. Shows sessions, transcripts, tool calls, tokens, and cache-aware cost per session and model; an opt-in emergency stop per session and pre-tool approvals for risky actions. Python, MIT, open-core: OpenClaw and NemoClaw are free, Gemini CLI and the other runtimes need ClawMetry Cloud or a self-hosted Pro license. Website

entries.name: Usage HUD
entries.description: Native macOS menu-bar meter that shows your Gemini CLI usage window next to Claude, Codex, Grok and Ollama, with a confidence label on every number. Paid, $9.

entries.name: OpenFiles
entries.description: VS Code extension (also on Open VSX for Cursor, Windsurf and VSCodium) that opens every file Gemini CLI edits so ESLint, TypeScript and other language servers check it, then returns the problems to Gemini CLI through an AfterTool hook in the same turn. Also works with Claude Code, Codex, Copilot and Cursor. MIT.

entries.name: Hermes Jailbench
entries.description: Repeatable jailbreak test harness for Anthropic/OpenAI-compatible endpoints. It emits deterministic refusal/partial/compliance classifications and includes a no-key dry-run and Gemini CLI extension.

entries.name: Archcore
entries.description: Git-native context engineering CLI and MCP server for AI coding agents; archcore init --agent gemini-cli wires Gemini CLI hooks and MCP.

entries.name: anotifier
entries.description: Desktop toasts, ntfy phone push and webhooks when Gemini CLI finishes a task or needs input, wired through its hooks by a one-command setup. Zero-dependency Node CLI whose single config also covers Claude Code, Codex CLI and Cursor.

entries.name: Agent Cat
entries.description: Free macOS/Windows menu-bar app that shows Gemini CLI and Antigravity usage and limits next to Claude Code and Codex, read from local files.

entries.name: Tokenmeter
entries.description: Desktop widget that shows Gemini CLI tokens today and over the last 7 days, alongside Claude Code, Codex and Copilot limits. Linux, Windows and macOS.

entries.name: Dazzler
entries.description: Agent Skill for frontend and document design (typography, palettes, 30 templates, offline design checks) with setup instructions for Gemini CLI.

entries.name: Caprock
entries.description: Local dashboard that starts Gemini CLI sessions and follows them through the telemetry file Gemini writes, on the same screens as Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode: live activity, token cost per repository, searchable history.

entries.name: Awakado
entries.description: macOS menu-bar app that keeps the Mac awake while Gemini CLI is working, using Gemini CLI hooks, and lets it sleep when it finishes. Also supports Claude Code, Codex and other agents. Free, with a paid Pro tier.

entries.name: SkillKeeper
entries.description: macOS menu bar app that reads local Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex and Cursor sessions to show which skills, agents, MCP servers and tools ran, how often, and what they cost in tokens. Native Swift, free to track.

entries.name: fakegreen
entries.description: Deterministic diff checker with an AfterAgent hook (npx fakegreen install gemini) that denies the turn when the agent skipped or deleted tests, weakened assertions, added suppressions, special-cased the test environment or forced CI green with || true, and feeds the findings back so Gemini fixes them. No LLM or API key. MIT.

entries.name: yoink
entries.description: Saves and switches Gemini CLI Google logins (oauth_creds.json and google_accounts.json) alongside Claude Code, Codex, Kimi Code and GitHub Copilot logins, from a CLI or a macOS menu bar app.

entries.name: MacMD Viewer
entries.description: Read-only Markdown viewer for macOS 14+ for the GEMINI.md and plan files Gemini CLI writes. Renders Mermaid diagrams and highlighted code, reloads when the file changes on disk, and adds Quick Look previews in Finder. Paid, $19.99 one-time.

entries.name: aisw
entries.description: Saves Gemini CLI logins and API keys as named profiles and switches the live ~/.gemini state in one command, alongside Claude Code, Codex CLI and Antigravity CLI. Docs: aiswitcher.dev.

entries.name: LynxPrompt
entries.description: Self-hosted web app that turns one set of AI coding rules into the file each tool reads: Gemini CLI's GEMINI.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, Cursor rules and Copilot instructions, 30 rule-file formats in all. Blueprints carry variables so a team shares one set across projects, and the lynxp CLI writes the files into each repository. AGPL-3.0.

entries.name: spillage
entries.description: Finds API keys in the chats, logs and checkpoints Gemini CLI keeps under ~/.gemini/tmp and in the MCP servers of ~/.gemini/settings.json, redacts them in place, and installs BeforeAgent / BeforeTool / SessionEnd hooks (spillage guard install) that block a prompt with a key in it and reads of .env. Python, no dependencies, no network; also covers Claude Code, Codex CLI and Cursor.

entries.name: Check
entries.description: Extension with a BeforeTool hook that checks each file write on your own machine before Gemini CLI makes it (and, on Linux, each shell command): files, folders, programs, git refs and packages it names must exist, and scripts must parse; what the machine proves wrong is blocked with the machine's message. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/golproductions/check-gemini. Paid, 14-day free trial.

entries.name: tokenreceipt
entries.description: Local CLI that reads Gemini CLI chat logs (plus Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and other agents) and prints a till-style receipt of tokens per agent and model, priced at public API list prices. Exports SVG/PNG cards or JSON; no account, no upload, no dependencies. MIT. Run: npx github:henrikdukefoss/tokenreceipt.

entries.name: Wardlume
entries.description: Locks the Mac's keyboard, mouse, and trackpad while Gemini CLI runs unattended, so progress stays visible but nobody can type into the session. Unlocks with Touch ID or Apple Watch; sandboxed with no network access.

entries.name: session-handoff-kit
entries.description: Agent Skill (open SKILL.md standard; installs into Gemini CLI with npx skills add alapha888/session-handoff-kit --agent gemini-cli) that ends a session with a structured handoff — goal state, decisions, files touched, open loops, next action — so the next session starts from facts instead of an over-full context. Also includes a context-hygiene checklist and a fill-in handoff template. MIT.

entries.name: agy-powerline
entries.description: Fast, configurable statusline for Antigravity CLI (agy), the successor to Gemini CLI, with real-time 5h/7d Gemini quota meters, pace markers, context usage, and interactive TUI editor. Zero dependencies, MIT.

entries.name: agentvcr
entries.description: Turns a Gemini CLI chat from ~/.gemini/tmp/*/chats (the JSONL format with rewinds and patches, or the older JSON files) into a self-contained HTML replay with a scrubbable timeline, diffs and terminal output, with API keys and other secrets masked locally first. Share it as a link through a secret gist on your own GitHub, embed it, export a Markdown transcript for a pull request, or have its GitHub Action comment the replay on agent PRs. Also reads Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode. MIT, no dependencies. Run: npx agentvcr-cli.

entries.name: SafetyCard
entries.description: Safety-check MCP servers and AI agents against the OWASP agentic Top 10, and get the safest setup to run them. Install with npx skills add safetycard/safetycard --agent gemini-cli.

entries.name: ChatVault
entries.description: Windows app that reads, searches and backs up your Gemini CLI chats across accounts, and continues any chat in Gemini CLI through a handoff file that carries the whole conversation.

entries.name: laya-guard
entries.description: Local guardrail with a BeforeTool hook for Gemini CLI (laya-guard install gemini-cli) that judges each shell command before it runs, using regex rules, protected paths, and a small on-device model. Blocked commands are denied; ones marked for review pass with a note. Also hooks into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and other agents. MIT.

entries.name: ratchet
entries.description: Code-size budget CLI (pip install ratchet-size): ratchet check refuses changes that grow source or test line counts past a ceiling, and only ratchet grant raises it. For Gemini CLI it is wired through a GEMINI.md instruction snippet (no hook); a CI check or git pre-commit hook enforces it.

entries.name: OpenMoat
entries.description: Local policy layer with a BeforeTool hook for Gemini CLI (openmoat init) that checks every shell command, file read and write, web request and MCP call against one policy before it runs, blocking what the policy denies. Adds an egress proxy, MCP server pinning and a hash-chained audit log, and the same policy covers Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other agents. Rust, MIT OR Apache-2.0.

entries.name: Scarwise
entries.description: Gemini CLI hooks (BeforeTool/AfterTool) that learn from failed tool calls by themselves and stop a known mistake before it runs; what one agent learns protects your other agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode and more).

entries.name: self-host
entries.description: Lets your agent install self-hosted apps on your own hardware and set them up (admin accounts, API keys, apps connected to each other), asking before each step.

entries.name: Agent Notifications
entries.description: Cross-platform desktop notifications and optional webhooks for Gemini CLI turn completion and tool permission requests. Also supports Claude Code, Codex CLI, OpenCode, Cursor CLI, and Qoder.

entries.name: DESIGN:OS
entries.description: Free design CLI and skill pack for Gemini CLI, Claude Code and Codex. Describe a UI in plain words and get web, Figma and SwiftUI output checked by deterministic taste gates; installs with npx @easestart/design-os init. Source-available (PolyForm Shield).

entries.name: Ironheights
entries.description: Offline security scanner that protects any AI bot's skills: scans any skill folder with a SKILL.md (including Gemini CLI skills in ~/.gemini/skills/) for prompt injection, credential theft, and other risky patterns before you install it, with findings tagged by OWASP LLM Top 10 and OpenCRE ID. Reads files as data, never runs them, no telemetry. Run npx ironheights scan ./path/to/skill. Apache-2.0.

entries.name: SRT Subtitle Translator Validator
entries.description: Browser-based tool to translate SRT subtitles using your Gemini subscription via CLI Proxy API with automatic validation/error correction - no API keys needed.

entries.name: Python Gemini CLI SDK
entries.description: Python SDK for Gemini CLI; API-compatible with Claude Code SDK.

entries.name: Gemini CLI Vercel AI SDK Provider
entries.description: Seamless Vercel AI SDK integration that unlocks Gemini's capabilities in Next.js and React applications with minimal configuration.

entries.name: geminicli2api
entries.description: Powerful FastAPI proxy that transforms Gemini CLI into standard API endpoints, enabling integration with any OpenAI-compatible tool or service.

entries.name: Gemini CLI Termux
entries.description: Provides a one-click deployment solution for Gemini CLI reverse proxy service for Android Termux users.

entries.name: gemini-openai-proxy
entries.description: Universal compatibility layer serving Gemini 2.5 Pro/Flash through OpenAI protocol. Works instantly with existing tools like LangChain, llama.cpp, and VS Code extensions.

entries.name: gemini-cli-openai
entries.description: Transform Google's Gemini models into OpenAI-compatible endpoints using Cloudflare Workers, powered the same infrastructure that drives the official Gemini CLI.

entries.name: gemini-cli-proxy
entries.description: OpenAI-compatible API wrapper for Gemini CLI as an OpenAI-compatible API service, allowing you to enjoy the free Gemini 2.5 Pro model through API!

entries.name: CLIProxyAPI
entries.description: Wrap Gemini CLI as an OpenAI/Gemini/Claude compatible API service, allowing you to enjoy the free Gemini 2.5 Pro model through API.

entries.name: gemini-cli-mcp-openai-bridge
entries.description: Server application that extends the Google Gemini CLI with MCP toolkit and OpenAI-compatible API bridge.

entries.name: TeamoRouter
entries.description: Hosted LLM gateway — managed alternative to self-hosted bridges. OpenAI-compatible and native Anthropic endpoints behind one API key; works with Gemini CLI, Claude Code, and Codex directly. Free permanent DeepSeek tiers (V4 Pro 200 req/day, V4 Flash 50 req/day, 1M ctx).

entries.name: Bifrost
entries.description: Self-hosted gateway for Gemini CLI that unifies cloud and local model providers with routing, fallbacks, load balancing, and MCP support.

entries.name: cliproxy-rs
entries.description: Rust rewrite of CLIProxyAPI with a built-in dashboard. Serves the Gemini API on a local endpoint (GOOGLE_GEMINI_BASE_URL), so Gemini CLI can run on Gemini API keys or on signed-in Claude and ChatGPT accounts.

entries.name: gemini-cli-prompt-library
entries.description: 30+ professional prompts for Gemini CLI.

entries.name: OrcaPromptVault
entries.description: Dated archive of the system prompts and tool schemas shipped AI agents send, including the one Gemini CLI itself puts on the wire.

entries.name: Shiori
entries.description: Open-source AI study companion powered by Gemini AI. Assignments tracker, SRS flashcards, GPA predictor, AI quiz generator, Pomodoro focus timer, and Claude Code MCP server. Live demo.

entries.name: Exam Cram Coach
entries.description: Agent Skill for exam prep that runs in Gemini CLI and other agents (npx skills add ZeKaiNie/universal-examprep-skill). Teaches from a student's own lecture slides, notes and past papers with file and page citations, crops figures from the PDFs, quizzes only from their homework and past papers, and keeps progress across sessions. English and Chinese.

entries.name: codecall
entries.description: Agent Skill that runs in Gemini CLI and other agents (npx skills add GAURAV-1313/codecall). Quizzes you on the code your agent just wrote, traces one request flow file by file, or plants one bug for a debugging-interview drill and restores it with Git. No API key.

entries.name: emem
entries.description: Shared, signed and content-addressed memory of the physical world that AI agents can read, cite, transfer and independently verify. 108 tools, no API key, no signup. Remote Streamable HTTP. Install: gemini extensions install https://emem.dev/gemini-extension.json.

entries.name: Lusha
entries.description: B2B prospecting and data enrichment: find and enrich contacts and companies with verified emails, direct dials, mobile numbers, and real-time buying signals. Remote MCP server bundled with 4 prospecting skills and OAuth sign-in. Works with Gemini CLI (gemini extensions install) and Antigravity (agy plugin install).

entries.name: nika
entries.description: Read-only oracle for Nika AI workflows: validate .nika.yaml DAGs, explain findings, browse schema/examples, honest cost estimate — before a single token is spent (single Rust binary, config: command nika, args [mcp]).

entries.name: ToolsForMCPServer
entries.description: Bridges Gemini CLI with Google Workspace through Apps Script integration, automating document processing, spreadsheet manipulation, and workflow automation.

entries.name: KubeStellar Console kc-agent
entries.description: Multi-cluster Kubernetes MCP server bridging Gemini CLI to kubeconfig and Kubernetes APIs. Manage clusters, policies, and 20+ CNCF project integrations across edge and cloud. Install via brew tap kubestellar/tap && brew install kc-agent.

entries.name: gemini-mcp-tool
entries.description: Leverages Gemini's industry-leading 2M token context window through MCP, enabling analysis of entire codebases and large documents that other tools can't handle.

entries.name: mcp-gemini-cli
entries.description: A simple MCP (Model Context Protocol) server wrapper for Google's Gemini CLI.

entries.name: gemini-cli-mcp
entries.description: Tool that enables using Gemini AI as an MCP server within Claude Code with large file analysis and token savings.

entries.name: gemini-mcp
entries.description: A simple MCP server for using the Gemini CLI.

entries.name: Xquik MCP
entries.description: X/Twitter data MCP server with 76 REST API endpoints, 20 extraction tools, account monitoring, and giveaway draws. Works with any MCP client including Gemini CLI.

entries.name: TokRepo MCP Server
entries.description: Search and install AI skills, prompts, MCP configs, and workflows from TokRepo from Gemini CLI and other MCP clients.

entries.name: prompt-to-asset
entries.description: MCP server that generates production-ready visual assets (app icons, favicons, OG images, logos, wordmarks) by routing requests across 30+ image generation models. Zero API key required for first run via Pollinations and Stable Horde free tiers. Works with any MCP client including Gemini CLI.

entries.name: TWZRD Agent Intel
entries.description: Trust scoring and identity verification for AI agent wallets on Solana. Verify agent identity before x402 micropayments or agent-initiated operations. Free: score_agent, preflight_check. Paid (x402): get_trust_receipt. Works with any MCP client including Gemini CLI.

entries.name: Unity-MCP
entries.description: Open-source MCP server connecting AI agents (including Gemini CLI) to the Unity Editor and runtime, with 100+ built-in tools.

entries.name: Godot-MCP
entries.description: Open-source MCP server connecting AI agents to the Godot Editor and runtime (Godot 4.x, C#).

entries.name: Unreal-MCP
entries.description: Open-source MCP server connecting AI agents to Unreal Engine 5.7, editor and runtime (C++ plugin + .NET sidecar).

entries.name: GameDev-MCP-Server
entries.description: Open-source, engine-agnostic MCP server shared by Unity-MCP, Godot-MCP, and Unreal-MCP.

entries.name: Find MCP
entries.description: Search 17,000+ MCP servers synced from the official MCP registry (registry.modelcontextprotocol.io). Remote Streamable HTTP (https://catalog.agentage.io/mcp, no auth for search) or stdio (npx -y @agentage/find-mcp). Works with Gemini CLI: gemini mcp add --transport http find-mcp https://catalog.agentage.io/mcp.

entries.name: GoodMemory
entries.description: Local-first durable memory for Gemini CLI through standalone MCP, with scoped recall, provenance and trace inspection, and explicit forgetting. Read-only by default with opt-in governed writes; install with npm install -g goodmemory@0.7.5 and follow the Gemini CLI setup guide.

entries.name: RunAPI MCP
entries.description: Remote MCP server for browsing model catalogs, checking pricing, and creating image, video, music, audio, and other model API tasks through RunAPI. Works with Gemini CLI: gemini mcp add --transport http runapi https://mcp.runapi.ai/mcp.

entries.name: AISO Tools MCP
entries.description: Query a catalog of 1,636 AI tools from the CLI: keyword/category/pricing search, side-by-side comparison, and alternatives lookup, with a canonical citation URL on every result. Remote Streamable HTTP, no API key. Works with any MCP client including Gemini CLI: gemini mcp add --transport http aisotools https://aisotools.com/api/mcp.

entries.name: Lians
entries.description: Open-source, local-first memory for Gemini CLI and other AI agents. Durable cross-session recall through a two-tool MCP extension, with no account or API key. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/Lians-ai/Lians.

entries.name: LWC
entries.description: Local-first, source-grounded project memory for Gemini CLI and other coding agents. Provides bounded recall, citations, atomic changesets, an installable Agent Skill, and a read-only stdio MCP server (lwc serve --mcp). Apache-2.0.

entries.name: Agent QA
entries.description: Source-available (FSL-1.1-ALv2) QA agent for natural-language web and mobile tests. Run agent-qa mcp for authoring, execution, artifacts, and failure triage; dashboard-backed tools need a running dashboard and dashboardUrl. Model and infrastructure costs are separate.

entries.name: deja-vu
entries.description: Local memory over the session files Gemini CLI and 19 other agents already write to disk, so a new session can search what you did before — including the months before you installed it. MCP tools plus auto-recall on every prompt; one Go binary, no network calls, MIT. Install: deja install gemini-auto.

entries.name: Mnemoverse Memory
entries.description: Hosted memory shared across MCP clients: write a memory in Gemini CLI, recall it in Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, or any other MCP client. Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in, no API key to paste. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/mnemoverse/gemini-extension.

entries.name: ContextStream
entries.description: Shared project context for Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Grok. Intelligence isn’t the bottleneck. Context is. Remote MCP for Gemini CLI and other coding agents: https://mcp.contextstream.io/mcp.

entries.name: squirrelscan
entries.description: Website audit MCP server for coding agents: run audits, read reports, and fix findings from Gemini CLI or any MCP client. 260+ rules across SEO, performance, security, accessibility, and agent experience, with fixes mapped to source. MIT CLI with a local stdio server (squirrel mcp) or hosted Remote MCP with OAuth: gemini mcp add --transport http squirrelscan https://mcp.squirrelscan.com/mcp.

entries.name: dsh-skills-anywhere
entries.description: MCP server that exposes every Agent Skill installed for Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and 60+ other agents, plus Claude Code plugin marketplaces and any GitHub skills repo, as find_skills/open_skill tools and skill:// resources, read in place with zero copies or symlinks.

entries.name: Glasser
entries.description: One key to 1,000+ paid third-party data APIs, pay per call: person and company enrichment, SEO and SERP, web scraping, places, news, scholar and social data. The agent searches the catalog, inspects the exact price, runs the endpoint and reports the charge; failed calls and empty results cost $0.00. Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in. Works with Gemini CLI: gemini mcp add --transport http glasser "https://api.glasser.ai/mcp?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli&utm_medium=mcp".

entries.name: Minds
entries.description: Synthetic market research: create AI audiences, interview them and run studies such as MaxDiff, conjoint and NPS. Remote MCP server with OAuth; installable as a Gemini CLI extension.

entries.name: SkillAgent
entries.description: Remote MCP server (Streamable HTTP, no auth) for searching ~3,500 agent skills, rules files (including Gemini rules) and MCP servers indexed hourly from GitHub, with project-based recommendations and per-agent install instructions for Gemini CLI. Install: gemini mcp add --transport http skillagent https://skillagent.dev/mcp.

entries.name: Vestige
entries.description: Memory system for coding agents: backfill ranks earlier records as candidate causes of a fresh failure even when they share no vocabulary with it, the composed graph records which memories were used together and surfaces never-tried combinations, retrieval decays on an FSRS-6 schedule, and receipts fail closed after compaction. Single Rust binary, local only. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/samvallad33/vestige-gemini.

entries.name: Oh My Android
entries.description: MCP server that lets Gemini CLI see and drive the Android Emulator on macOS: screenshots, UI tree in dp, tap/type, dark mode, RTL, font scale, logcat. Free, MIT, native macOS app (macOS 26+, Apple silicon) with a built-in stdio server. Install: gemini mcp add --scope user oh-my-android ohmyandroid-mcp.

entries.name: Hyperconsciousness
entries.description: Developer-alpha encrypted, append-only knowledge store with a Rust CLI and stdio MCP server. Gives agents scoped, expiring access to notes and supports device sync. MIT licensed.

entries.name: Bestax
entries.description: MCP server that gives coding agents the props, examples, CSS variables and Agent Skills for the Bestax React component library (Bulma v1). Runs offline.

entries.name: Court Rules
entries.description: U.S. federal court rules, local rules, judge standing orders and court holidays with filing deadline checks, over a hosted MCP server. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/foklepoint/court-rules-mcp.

entries.name: LogNorm
entries.description: Hosted remote MCP server that hands a website's SEO and AI-visibility (GEO) backlog (site audits, fixes, content drafts, AI-answer tracking) to coding agents. Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in, no API key; free plan available. Source: lognorm/lognorm-mcp. Add with: gemini mcp add --transport http lognorm https://lognorm.com/api/mcp.

entries.name: Connections
entries.description: Work a free Connections contact book, follow-ups, ticketed event pages, notes and email from Gemini CLI; no card needed for the account. Remote Streamable HTTP MCP server with OAuth sign-in at https://studio.connections.icu/v1/mcp. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/Lunarwerx/connections-gemini-extension.

entries.name: LinkMCP
entries.description: Hosted LinkedIn MCP server for your own LinkedIn account: profile and company lookups, people and Sales Navigator search, inbox, posts and comments, connection requests, and work email finding. Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in; the server is closed source. Paid plans from $19/month, 7-day free trial without a card. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/linkmcp-io/linkmcp.

entries.name: FXMacroData
entries.description: Official macroeconomic releases, central bank decisions, release calendars, FX rates and COT positioning for 22 currencies, with release timestamps and source links. Remote Streamable HTTP server; USD releases (last 90 days, 15-minute delay), the USD calendar and the USD catalogue work with no sign-in or API key, other currencies and FX rates need a key. Add with: gemini mcp add --transport http fxmacrodata https://mcp.fxmacrodata.com.

entries.name: Selvedge
entries.description: Local SQLite decision memory for Gemini CLI via stdio MCP, storing explicit decisions, reasons, and rejected approaches for retrieval across sessions. Setup: selvedge setup --agent gemini.

entries.name: Unsora
entries.description: AI content generation and social media scheduling from Gemini CLI: generate images, video, music and voiceovers, clip long videos into short clips, and schedule or publish posts to YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, Bluesky, Threads and Pinterest. Official open-source MCP server (AGPL-3.0, in apps/mcp), hosted as remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in or an API key. Paid plans from $19/month with a 3-day free trial. Add with: gemini mcp add --transport http unsora https://mcp.tryunsora.com/mcp.

entries.name: MAQAMI Travel
entries.description: Hotel and flight search and booking from Gemini CLI: search hotels (3M+) and flights, read hotel details and reviews, then send the customer a secure checkout link on book.maqami.co for the offer they choose. Remote Streamable HTTP (https://mcp.maqami.co/), no sign-in or API key. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/negm17111995/mcp-server.

entries.name: looot
entries.description: Remote MCP server (OAuth sign-in) that searches, prices and runs 2,500+ data API endpoints from 90+ providers (emails, phones, company and people search, Google results, web pages) on one prepaid balance. Ships a Gemini CLI extension manifest.

entries.name: BulkPublish
entries.description: Draft, schedule, cross-post and analyze social media posts on 15 platforms (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, LinkedIn, Bluesky and more) from Gemini CLI. Hosted Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in, or local stdio via npx -y @bulkpublish/mcp-server with an API key; free plan available. MIT. Add with: gemini mcp add --transport http bulkpublish https://mcp.bulkpublish.com/mcp.

entries.name: QRX
entries.description: Turn a text prompt and a link into an artistic, branded QR code from Gemini CLI. Each code is checked to scan before it is returned and uses a hosted qrx.to short link. Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in or an API key, or local stdio via npx -y @qrxcodes/mcp. MIT. Add with: gemini mcp add --transport http qrx https://qrx.codes/mcp.

entries.name: Tapetide MCP
entries.description: Indian stock market data for Gemini CLI: quotes, quarterly financials, shareholding, a 326-ratio screener, FII/DII flows, option chains and company filings for about 8,200 NSE and BSE stocks. Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth or a free personal token, or local stdio via npx -y tapetide-mcp; free plan available. MIT. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/Tapetide-hq/nse-bse-indian-stock-market-data-mcp.

entries.name: Hoot Lens
entries.description: Session replays and click heatmaps from real website visits. Find clicks that broke, jump to the JavaScript error and source line, and check whether a fix helped. Remote with OAuth (httpUrl: https://mcp.hootlens.com/mcp) or local with npx -y @hootlens/mcp. Demo with sample data, no sign-in: https://mcp.hootlens.com/demo.

entries.name: Blawgy
entries.description: Run your SEO blog from Gemini CLI. Research keywords, manage the content plan, write and update SEO blog posts with images and internal links, publish them to WordPress, Shopify, Webflow, Wix, Framer, Ghost and Duda, and read Search Console traffic, rankings and indexing status. Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in or an API key; the server is closed source, included on every paid plan with a free trial. Add with gemini mcp add --transport http blawgy https://app.blawgy.com/mcp.

entries.name: DropTheHassle
entries.description: Lets Gemini CLI publish the site it built on a real HTTPS link instead of localhost: a free link, no account needed. For your own .com it hands the human a €19/$19-a-year payment link; after payment the site goes live on it with no DNS. No tool spends money. For claimed sites, ask it for visitors, leads or site status. Remote Streamable HTTP, no sign-in for the first publish, or local stdio via npx -y dropthehassle-mcp. MIT. Add with: gemini mcp add --transport http dropthehassle https://dropthehassle.com/mcp.

entries.name: LinkedNav
entries.description: Hosted MCP server for LinkedIn outreach in your own LinkedNav account: find leads, launch campaigns, send, and reply. LinkedNav detects LinkedIn buying signals and sends personalized outreach you approve. Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in or an API key; the server is closed source. Free 7-day trial. An independent service, not affiliated with LinkedIn. Add with: gemini mcp add --transport http linkednav https://mcp.linkednav.com/.

entries.name: HeyReagent
entries.description: Hosted LinkedIn MCP server for your own LinkedIn account: read your inbox, send messages and invitations, search people, and work with posts. Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in, no key to paste; the server is closed source. Free plan available. An independent service, not affiliated with LinkedIn. Add with: gemini mcp add --transport http heyreagent https://api.heyreagent.com/mcp.

entries.name: SolidPing
entries.description: Uptime and synthetic monitoring with a remote MCP server (OAuth) to create, run and diagnose checks. Works with Gemini CLI: gemini mcp add --transport http solidping https://solidping.io/api/v1/mcp.

entries.name: Latchkey
entries.description: Self-healing GitHub Actions runners with a hosted MCP server for coding agents: read the CI failures self-heal could not fix (root cause, failing file, logs), check run status, dispatch workflows, and run commands on fresh ephemeral runners. Remote Streamable HTTP with a Latchkey API key; the server is closed source. Add with: gemini mcp add --transport http latchkey https://latchkey.dev/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer $LATCHKEY_TOKEN".

entries.name: Aident Loadout
entries.description: Hosted MCP server that gives Gemini CLI and other MCP clients one reusable setup for apps like GitHub, Slack, Gmail, Linear and Notion, plus 400+ expert-built Skills and built-in services (search, scraping, media generation) billed from one balance. Accounts are connected once in the browser and kept in Aident Vault, and every action is logged in Audit. Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in; free pay-as-you-go start. Add with: gemini mcp add --transport http aident https://loadout.aident.ai/mcp.

entries.name: CurlShot
entries.description: Screenshot API with a hosted MCP server: take_screenshot renders any web page in a real browser and returns the image (PNG, JPEG, WebP or PDF; full page, device presets, ad and cookie-banner blocking), so Gemini CLI can see a page, and list_devices lists the presets. Remote Streamable HTTP with a CurlShot API key; the server is closed source. Free plan of 100 screenshots a month, no card. Add with: gemini mcp add --transport http curlshot https://curlshot.com/api/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer $CURLSHOT_API_KEY".

entries.name: Pethost
entries.description: Hosting for Docker Compose projects with a remote MCP server (OAuth): Gemini CLI deploys a project, reads its logs and HTTP traffic, and rolls it back. Add it with gemini mcp add --transport http pethost https://mcp.pethost.dev/mcp.

entries.name: DC Hub
entries.description: Live data for data-center site selection: a daily Data Center Power Index (DCPI) of where data centers can get grid power across 300+ markets, live grid feeds from the seven US ISOs, plus fiber, gas and electricity prices. Answers carry an as-of timestamp and a citation line. 94 tools, remote Streamable HTTP, free tier needs no key. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/azmartone67/dchub-mcp-server.

entries.name: Google Hotels MCP
entries.description: Search Google Hotels and Google Vacation Rentals from Gemini CLI: per-OTA nightly rates (Booking.com, Expedia, Agoda, Vrbo, Airbnb, Hotels.com and 10+ other providers), 3-month daily price calendars, amenities, nearby places and review topics. Local stdio server (3 tools) wrapping Apify Google Hotels actors; uvx --from "git+https://github.com/huynhtanan/google-hotels-mcp.git@v0.1.2" google-hotels-mcp.

entries.name: AltoRank
entries.description: Open-source SEO content software with a hosted MCP server: check whether search engines and AI crawlers can read a site, research keywords, read Google Search Console, and write sourced drafts into a person's review queue. No approve or publish tool. AGPL-3.0 and self-hostable (source). Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in. Add with gemini mcp add --transport http altorank https://app.altorank.co/api/mcp.

entries.name: Firecrawl
entries.description: Official Firecrawl MCP server for web search, page scraping to markdown or JSON, and site crawling. The hosted server works keyless (rate limited) with search, scrape and parse; add an API key for crawl, map and the rest. The open-source server is MIT (source). Add with: gemini mcp add --transport http firecrawl https://mcp.firecrawl.dev/v2/mcp.

entries.name: npmscan
entries.description: npm supply-chain security: checks packages for malware, known vulnerabilities, typosquats, maintainer takeovers and risky install scripts before install, and audits package.json, lockfiles, SBOMs and PR dependency changes. 23 read-only tools, no API key, no signup. Remote Streamable HTTP, bundled with 5 skills as a Gemini CLI extension. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/salemalem/npmscan-mcp-plugin.

entries.name: deed.page
entries.description: Static hosting for agents with a remote MCP server that lets Gemini CLI publish an HTML file or static folder to a permanent public https://<slug>.deed.page URL and update it with the token it gets back. No account or API key for publishing; the companion Agent Skill is MIT (source). Remote Streamable HTTP. Add with gemini mcp add --transport http deed-page https://deed.page/mcp.

entries.name: ppl
entries.description: Personal CRM for humans with AI agents, with a hosted remote MCP server (OAuth) at https://withppl.com/mcp: Gemini CLI can look up contacts, log interactions, keep notes and set reminders about the people in your life. Free beta up to 1,000 contacts at https://withppl.com/register.

entries.name: Super
entries.description: Permission-gated superuser (sysadmin) MCP server that lets Gemini CLI check system status, disks and processes, run shell commands and read GitHub, behind a dangerous-command denylist, human approval gates, optional Cisco AI Defense and Duo authorization, and an append-only audit log. Python, local stdio; pip install superuser, then add the superuser command to your Gemini CLI MCP server config.

entries.name: Cooper Email
entries.description: Email inboxes for agents with a hosted Streamable HTTP MCP server at https://cooperemail.com/mcp (OAuth or API key): Gemini CLI gets its own username@cooperemail.com address to send, read, and reply to mail and wait for replies or sign-up codes. The free plan includes 5 inboxes.

entries.name: CodeTrendy
entries.description: Search CodeTrendy, a curated directory of newly launched startups, SaaS tools and indie products, from Gemini CLI: keyword search with category and pricing filters, full listing profiles, alternatives to a named product, trending listings and the site of the day. 7 read-only tools. Remote Streamable HTTP, no API key, no account: gemini mcp add --transport http codetrendy https://codetrendy.com/api/mcp.

entries.name: BlockVectra
entries.description: MCP server for Robinhood Chain and multiple EVM networks. Connect over remote Streamable HTTP to discover chains and read docs without a key; RPC access follows each chain's policy, while Data API and account tools need an API key. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/blockvectra/mcp --ref main.

entries.name: MEDIAPRONET
entries.description: Search the MEDIAPRONET launch and discovery directory from Gemini CLI: keyword search over newly launched startups, SaaS tools and online products (category and pricing filters), full listing profiles, alternatives to a named product, categories and what is trending. 7 read-only tools. Remote Streamable HTTP, no API key, no account. Works with any MCP client including Gemini CLI: gemini mcp add --transport http mediapronet https://mediapronet.com/api/mcp.

entries.name: LLMSlim
