entries.description: Long-term memory for Gemini CLI and other MCP clients over a local stdio MCP server. Five tools (remember, recall, list_memories, forget, fit_context): messages are stored word for word in local SQLite or your own Postgres, and recall returns the stored messages that answer a question within a token budget, with no LLM call inside. MIT. Install: pip install "llmslim[mcp]", then gemini mcp add --scope user llmslim llmslim mcp.

entries.name: Aria Icons
entries.description: MCP server with 12 tools for searching ~1.4M open-source SVG icons and adding them as SVG or React/Vue/Svelte/Solid components; remote endpoint needs no auth. Add with gemini mcp add --transport http aria-icons https://icons.leularia.com/api/mcp.

entries.name: SitePatent
entries.description: Search SitePatent, a screened discovery platform for newly launched startups, tools and online products, from Gemini CLI: keyword search with category and pricing filters, full listing profiles, alternatives to a named product, categories and trending listings. 7 read-only tools. Remote Streamable HTTP, no API key, no account: gemini mcp add --transport http sitepatent https://sitepatent.com/api/mcp.

entries.name: MarketMirror
entries.description: Gemini CLI extension and MCP server that tests ads, prices, emails and sales pitches on simulated buyers and writes a go / iterate / no-go report. Install with gemini extensions install https://github.com/DarkWorldCoder/market-mirror.

entries.name: BrewPage
entries.description: MCP server for brewpage.app, free hosting with no account: Gemini CLI publishes HTML, Markdown, files, multi-file static sites, JSON and key-value data and gets a shareable link back (20 tools). Connect to the remote endpoint https://brewpage.app/mcp (no auth) or install the extension with gemini extensions install https://github.com/kochetkov-ma/brewpage-openapi. Content expires after 15 days by default (up to 30).

entries.name: Model Salt
entries.description: MCP server that gives the model randomness from outside it, so one prompt gives different pictures, stories, names and designs that still do what you asked. One tool, model_salt; add it with npx -y model-salt setup gemini. MIT.

entries.name: Landed MCP
entries.description: Hosted MCP server for job search in Gemini CLI: rank AI and tech jobs against a role brief, read application forms, and fetch interview prep. No key needed.

entries.name: NeverApply
entries.description: Hosted job-search MCP server for Gemini CLI: search and match jobs, tailor resumes, answer screening questions, prepare for interviews, and apply to jobs with your approval. Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in, no API key; free plan available. Add with: gemini mcp add --transport http neverapply https://neverapply.co/mcp.

entries.name: Carbon Forge
entries.description: Hosted MCP server for source control and a shared record: Gemini CLI can read and write code, files and prose in one record on the server, open a lane instead of cloning, and land a change as one all-or-nothing changeset. Remote Streamable HTTP at https://carbonforge.dev/api/mcp; public workspaces read without a token, writing needs a bearer token.

entries.name: Tera Studio
entries.description: Hosted MCP server for singers over remote Streamable HTTP, no key or sign-in: find_song_key looks up a well-known song's key, tempo and typical vocal range by title, and the other tools return links to free browser tools that find a song file's key and BPM or move it up to 6 semitones. Add with gemini mcp add --transport http tera-studio https://terastudio.co/mcp.

entries.name: MCP Probe Kit
entries.description: Diagnostics and self-test toolkit for MCP servers: enumerates every tool, resource and prompt, exercises them, and reports health, latency and schema drift between runs. Read-only against the target server, so you can point it at any server you connect Gemini CLI to and see what it actually exposes. MIT, npx -y mcp-probe-kit, official MCP Registry io.github.mybolide/mcp-probe-kit.

entries.name: Coding Tools MCP
entries.description: Desktop MCP workspace for coding agents: file edits, command execution, Git status and resumable history sessions behind one local stdio interface, so Gemini CLI gets project scaffolding and code search without four separate servers. Apache-2.0, official MCP Registry io.github.mybolide/coding-tools-mcp.

entries.name: Budna MCP
entries.description: Read-only MCP server for Budna, a Swedish second-hand marketplace: search and inspect public listings, categories, filters, seller profiles, and bid and rating summaries from Gemini CLI. 11 tools, interactive listing cards in MCP Apps clients. Local stdio, no API key, no account. MIT. Run with npx --yes @budna-marketplace/mcp.

entries.name: BankBridge
entries.description: Hosted MCP server that lets Gemini CLI answer questions about your own US bank, credit card and investment accounts: spending by category or merchant, recurring charges, monthly cashflow, holdings. 12 read-only tools, data fetched live on each call; it can't move money. Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in. Paid, $5/mo per connected bank. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/bankbridge-money/bankbridge-plugin, then /mcp auth bankbridge.

entries.name: Tavero
entries.description: MCP server and CLI that finds UI inconsistencies (spacing, colors, typography, component drift) in running React apps and gives coding agents fixes with file/line references. Works with Gemini CLI as an MCP server. Run: npx -y tavero mcp. Free, MIT.

entries.name: GetYouTubeTranscript
entries.description: YouTube transcripts and data for Gemini CLI: fetch a video's transcript (pick the language, optional timestamps), search YouTube, browse a channel's videos, playlists and posts, search inside a channel, list a playlist, find related videos, and read a channel banner or estimated dislikes. 13 tools. Hosted Streamable HTTP; tool calls need an API key from the dashboard (1 credit per call, 100 credits on sign-up, paid plans from $5/month). MIT. Add with: gemini mcp add --transport http --header "Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>" getyoutubetranscript https://getyoutubetranscript.com/api/mcp.

entries.name: recall
entries.description: MCP server that reads and writes Claude Code's per-project auto memory (Markdown files with [[wiki-links]]), so Gemini CLI, Codex and Cursor share the same memories. memory_recall follows links within a token budget; optional read-only mode. Zero dependencies, local only. MIT. Install with gemini extensions install https://github.com/fainir/recall (serves the memory of the folder you start Gemini in) or run npx -y @fainir/recall.

entries.description: A Neovim plugin to integrate Gemini CLI well (+ Qwen Code now).

entries.name: gemini-cli.nvim
entries.description: Native Neovim integration bringing Gemini's AI capabilities directly into your editor with keybindings, commands, and buffer manipulation support.

entries.name: gemini-nvim
entries.description: Gemini CLI in neovim - An unofficial Neovim plugin for interacting with Google Gemini CLI.

entries.description: Turn Gemini CLI into a multi-agent platform — 12 specialized subagents, parallel dispatch, 4-phase orchestration, and standalone dev tools for code review, debugging, security, and performance.

entries.name: GACUA
entries.description: The world's first out-of-the-box computer use agent powered by Gemini CLI @openmule.

entries.name: gemini-code-flow
entries.description: Enterprise-grade orchestration framework that coordinates multiple Gemini CLI instances for complex development tasks, based on battle-tested Claude Code Flow patterns.

entries.name: gemini-cli-commands-demo
entries.description: A proof-of-concept demonstrating a sub-agent orchestration system built within the Gemini CLI.

entries.name: Emdash Skills
entries.description: 14-category autonomous product-building OS with 18 specialized agents. Turns one-line prompts into deployed products. Includes GEMINI.md compatibility for cross-tool portability. Skills cover architecture, planning, quality, brand, media, observability, and deployment on Cloudflare Workers.

entries.description: ~30 pro-tips for effectively using Gemini CLI for agentic coding.

entries.description: Essential collection of extensions and commands that enhance Gemini CLI with additional capabilities and workflow improvements.

entries.description: Gemini CLI extension that adds Gemini API docs and MCP.

entries.description: Collection of demo scenario and casts for Gemini CLI.

entries.description: Practical tips for Antigravity CLI (agy), the official successor to Gemini CLI.

entries.description: Source-linked guide to Gemini CLI daily request quotas, the free-tier change, and per-token API cost.

entries.description: One MCP server (Context7) configured in Gemini CLI's settings.json alongside Claude Code, Codex CLI, OpenCode and goose, using each tool's documented syntax, with sources dated.

entries.name: Git-Alchemist
entries.description: A unified AI-powered CLI tool for automating GitHub repository management (issues, PRs, topics, profiles) powered by Gemini 3 and Gemma 3.

entries.name: toprank
entries.description: Claude Code plugin for SEO and Google Ads that includes a Gemini cross-model review skill. Uses Gemini for second-opinion reviews on Google Ads campaigns, SEO metadata, and schema markup — leveraging Gemini's native Google ecosystem knowledge for higher-quality decisions than Claude alone. MIT, 107 stars.

entries.name: NotFair
entries.description: Open-source Claude Code skills for SEO, GEO, Google Ads, and Meta Ads. Connects to live data via Google Ads MCP, Meta Ads MCP, Google Search Console MCP, and Google Analytics (GA4) MCP. Includes a /notfair:gemini cross-model review skill that runs Gemini as a second-opinion gate on ad campaigns, SEO metadata, and schema markup. MIT, ~2.9k stars.
